name: Disable Background Apps
description: Disables background activity for supported Windows Store and packaged applications to reduce resource usage. Some features like live notifications or cloud sync may stop working until you sign out of the account.

description_i18n.en: Disables background activity for supported Windows Store and packaged applications to reduce resource usage. Some features like live notifications or cloud sync may stop working until you sign out of the account.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Hintergrundaktivitäten für unterstützte Microsoft-Store-Anwendungen, um Ressourcen zu sparen. Funktionen wie Live-Benachrichtigungen oder Cloud-Synchronisation funktionieren möglicherweise nicht mehr, bis Sie sich abmelden müssen.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive l'activité en arrière-plan pour les applications du Store Windows et empaquetées afin de réduire la consommation des ressources. Certaines fonctionnalités comme les notifications ou la synchronisation cloud peuvent cesser de fonctionner jusqu'à ce que vous vous déconnectiez.

warnings.title: App features may stop working
warnings.message: Some applications such as Mail or Calendar will no longer update live information while minimized. You must sign out and back into your account for changes to take effect

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets the GlobalUserDisabled registry value to 1 under HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\BackgroundAccessApplications, which applies a policy that prevents supported packaged apps from running in the background
